name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my windows or home before a sill replacement project?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my windows or home before a sill replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a window sill replacement, you can prepare by clearing the area around the window, both inside and out, to allow easy access for the crew. Remove any window treatments, personal items, or furniture that might obstruct the work. If it's an exterior sill, ensure plants or obstacles directly beneath the window are moved. Maine Results, Inc. appreciates customers ensuring a clear workspace, which helps our team work more efficiently and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area around the window, inside and out, removing window treatments and any obstructing items.
